verdict.rationale: Blink Shell is an iOS terminal and coding environment, so shipping local git commands such as stash is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence lists its local commands (cat, grep, ls, cp, etc.) and mentions connecting to VS Code and Codespaces, but nowhere documents git or stash/unstash support. Running git on a remote host over SSH is a user-side workaround and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can stash and unstash changes to temporarily clear my working directory
